gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Total revenues 5,564,490 = General 2,241,636 + Street 529,815 + Debt Service 2,545,434 + Capital Projects 247,605 (no other fund columns). Detail: GF departments pp13-16 2,241,636 (ties) + Street budget schedule p10 529,029 + Debt Service p11 2,510,962 (incl. Bond proceeds 1,530,000) + Capital Projects p12 278,117 = 5,559,744. Differences are budgetary vs GAAP: Street +786 (sales tax 113,008 vs 112,222); Debt Service +34,472 (property 440,374 vs 438,582 = +1,792; sales 235,592 vs 202,912 = +32,680); Capital Projects -30,512 (the budget schedule prints Sales 30,512 that the GAAP column has as '-'). 786 + 34,472 - 30,512 = 4,746 = gap. No missing or duplicate lines; no fix.

Statement p5 Total expenditures 5,219,445 = General 2,262,984 + Street 474,807 + Debt Service 2,105,523 + Capital Projects 376,131. No fix.

Statement p5 Total column prints one net 'Transfers from (to) other funds' 50,274 = General 144,988 + Street 315,000 - Debt Service 294,714 - Capital Projects 115,000. Detail records transfers gross per fund/department: GF Equipment +129,170 (p15) + GF Pool +15,818 (p16) + Street +315,000 (p10) = 459,988 in; Debt Service -294,714 (p11) and Capital Projects -115,000 (p12) = 409,714 out. 459,988 - 409,714 = 50,274 = statement net.
